ConnectionStrings.__comment: Postgres is a DEPLOY input — provided per-environment (dev value in appsettings.Development.json; production via environment/secret store). Empty here so a mis-provisioned host fails closed at startup (see Program.cs) instead of silently binding a committed credential.

Billing.__comment: Store receipt-verification credentials are DEPLOY inputs — never commit secrets. Empty defaults keep google_play / app_store returning NotConfigured (endpoint 501) until real creds are supplied via environment/secret store (see docs/production-readiness.md). SandboxSecret is dev-only and lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Passkey.__comment: WebAuthn/FIDO2 relying party. Real passkeys require these to match a live HTTPS domain + app-signing cert (see PasskeyOptions). ServerDomain is the RP id (registrable domain, no scheme); Origins is the exact clientDataJSON.origin the authenticator stamps. AppleAppIds (<TEAMID>.<bundle-id>) and Android package + SHA-256 fingerprints feed /.well-known/apple-app-site-association and /.well-known/assetlinks.json.
